resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county table gives 100 feet, while the 1959 survey note gives 110 feet overall. The story reports both; the facts keep the table height.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA Minnesota list and the Hubbard County tower PDF were read. The Wikipedia Farris page was checked and has no tower mention, so it is not cited. No removal date or demolition account was found, so the date of loss is open and the story does not give one. The table height (100 ft) and the 1959 survey height (110 ft) disagree; both are in the story. The directory's Steamboat Hubbard entry (47.06813, -94.73484) is also gone and its own record should note the 1952 move to Farris. Confidence is medium: the 1952 move and the Steamboat origin come from one county list, and the gone status from the directory alone.
